findings.evidence: docs/modules/plans/api.md, GET /api/plans/{planId} Error Codes table: '404 | `Not found` | No plan matches `{ id: planId, userId }` (covers both "does not exist" and "belongs to another user")' - this is exactly the case of a different authenticated user fetching a plan they do not own.
findings.locationHint: - [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] `docs/modules/plans/overview.md` states the fetch is "owned by the current user" but does not state the response code or behavior when a different, authenticated user requests a plan they do not own (e.g. 404 vs. 403). This could not be confirmed from the reviewed module-docs.
findings.message: This document claims the response code for a non-owner fetch of a plan is unconfirmed, but the sibling generated doc docs/modules/plans/api.md already documents it: GET /api/plans/{planId} returns 404 'Not found' when the plan does not match {id, userId}, explicitly covering the 'belongs to another user' case.

findings.evidence: docs/modules/planned-items/api.md, POST /api/plans/{planId}/items Error Codes table: '404 | Not Found | No plan with the given `planId` exists for the authenticated user (`prisma.plan.findFirst({ where: { id: planId, userId } })` returns null)' - this is exactly the cross-user item-creation-rejection scenario.
findings.locationHint: - Per `docs/modules/planned-items/overview.md`, the module is described as enforcing "that a planned item can only be created under a plan owned by the authenticated user"; the item creation is therefore expected to be rejected. [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] The exact response status code and error body for this rejection are not stated in `docs/modules/planned-items/overview.md` and could not be confirmed.
findings.message: This document claims the status code/error body for a cross-user item-creation rejection is unconfirmed, but the sibling generated doc docs/modules/planned-items/api.md already documents it: POST /api/plans/{planId}/items returns 404 with error body {"error": "Not Found"}/{"error": "Not found"} when the plan is not owned by the authenticated user.

findings.evidence: docs/modules/plans/api.md, DELETE /api/plans/{planId} Error Codes table: '404 | `Not found` | Ownership check (`prisma.plan.findFirst({ where: { id: planId, userId }, select: { id: true } })`) finds nothing before the delete is attempted' - this states both the status code and that the delete is never attempted (so the plan remains undeleted).
findings.locationHint: - Per `docs/modules/plans/overview.md`, plan deletion is described as occurring "after verifying ownership". [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] The exact response when ownership verification fails (status code, whether Plan P remains undeleted) is not stated in the reviewed module-docs and could not be confirmed.
findings.message: This document claims the status code and undeleted-outcome for a failed ownership check on DELETE are unconfirmed, but the sibling generated doc docs/modules/plans/api.md already documents both: it returns 404 'Not found' and the delete is never attempted (i.e. the plan remains undeleted) when the ownership check finds nothing.
